title: DRBD: Add support for new packets including the P_RS_DAGTAG family
description:
DRBD: Add support for new packets including the P_RS_DAGTAG family

These were recently added to the DRBD protocol. See the following
commits at https://github.com/LINBIT/drbd-headers: \
098b1fdcdbaa introduce new P_RS_CANCEL_AHEAD\
e5d5e6fa9af7 add P_DISCONNECT to stop connect-attempts\
1681c4b0166e add dagtag resync request packets

---

DRBD: Correct GitHub URL

---

DRBD: Remove some unnecessary `_U_` attributes

We do use these parameters, so `_U_` is unnecessary and misleading.

---

I am also planning on making a series of further small improvements to the DRBD dissector. Any preference whether I submit them as lots of tiny MRs? Add them to this MR? Submit a few commits at a time like this? Thanks!

notes.body:
Hi Joel,

Look good, we can merge if you want, 
i think it is better to make small commit on the same MR (but not too small too ;-))

Thanks for looking at the changes. Please merge it. I'll collect together my further changes as a commit series in one MR. None of the other commits will be as small as "DRBD: Correct GitHub URL" :smile:
